heading: Sense of expression once explained.
text: Every expression which is explained in any part of this Code, is used in every part of this Code in conformity with the explanation.
status_note: The Act is repealed. Kept in India Code's 'Repeal Acts' collection; record title reads 'The Indian Penal Code, 45 of 1860 (Rep., Act 45 of 2023)' (read 2026-11-21)
